name: inspira-animated-tabs
blurb: Animated tabs with smooth spring transitions and stacked layout.
description: Tab component with spring-based animations. Tabs can be controlled or uncontrolled. Supports custom className for container/active/tab/content areas.
use_when: Interactive experiences where animated tab transitions are a feature, not just utility.
a11y: Tab buttons are keyboard-navigable with proper ARIA roles. Content regions properly labeled.
